title: Popcorn · storyboards in Fuobe Soul's looks
description: Runs the Storyboard (POST /api/storyboards, priced by /api/storyboards/estimate) with a Fuobe Soul look (build plan O13): frame 1 on Fuobe Soul with the look's LoRAs and words, the next frames from the frame before (Nano Banana Pro edits in the cloud, Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 + the next-scene LoRA on your GPU) with the look's words; the look's grade and overlay are applied in the browser after, so scores are of the raw frames. Continuity is how well the frames hold together; the no-look case is the board as it was before.
